summary: Harden #645 shadow gates: durable .agentic/shadow previews so shadow_ack survives process restart; gate_high_impact auto-opens #648 checkpoints on block; run_procedure returns checkpoint_id with shadow_required.
migration_impact: New on-disk previews under .agentic/shadow/<shadow_id>.json (repo-local, similar to checkpoints/ledger). Blocked high-impact gates may create pending checkpoints under .agentic/checkpoints/. No config schema change.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate_core so plate_autonomy_simulate persists shadow_id durably.
2. After simulate in one process/session, pass the same shadow_id + approved to gate/run_procedure in another process.
3. On shadow_required, read checkpoint_id and decide via plate_checkpoint_decide / gh plate checkpoint decide.
4. Optionally gitignore .agentic/shadow/ and .agentic/checkpoints/ if local-only (ledger/checkpoint conventions already apply).
agent_notes: Prefer durable shadow_ack over re-simulate (re-simulate mints a new id). When status=shadow_required, surface checkpoint in feed and pause unsupervised cycles. Full worktree/fork shadow diffs remain a later #645 slice.
